title: Restore Saudi Arabia stream after shootout vip slot swap
body: ## Summary Fixes both streams showing Spain during the Uruguay vs Spain penalty shootout. worldkoora swapped which match each vip slot carries mid-game; Saudi Arabia (beIN MAX 3) was lost. ## Routing change (v7) | Channel | Was (v6) | Now (v7) | Match | |---------|----------|----------|-------| | beIN MAX 3 | vip1 | **vip2** | Cape Verde vs Saudi Arabia | | beIN Sports 1 | vip2 | **vip1** | Uruguay vs Spain | Per-match `embedKey` pinned in `today.json` so the watch page uses the correct slot even if bindings drift. ## Deploy Merge and deploy Worker — hard-refresh watch page (`?v=20260630b`). If still wrong after deploy, upstream may have flipped again; use admin panel (PR #34) for live override without waiting for git.
